issues.description: Farm.animals visibility differs between specification and solution: the UML in the problem statement defines the field as private (`- animals: List<Animal>`), but the solution declares it as `public List<Animal> animals;`. This undermines the intended encapsulation and conflicts with the instruction to use getter/setter access.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution field to `private List<Animal> animals;` and keep access via `getAnimals()`/`setAnimals()` (update any direct field access if present).

issues.description: Template Farm.singFarmSongVerse signature does not match the specified design: the template comments out the `Animal` parameter (`private void singFarmSongVerse(/*Animal animal*/)`), while the UML/specification requires `singFarmSongVerse(animal: Animal)` and the solution implements `private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)`. This can mislead students into implementing a parameterless helper, which makes animal-specific verse printing awkward or impossible without relying on external state.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template to `private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)` (and add/import `Animal` as needed) so it matches the UML/spec and supports printing animal-specific verses.
